newsitem.title: USA: Advanta retains adviser, COO resigns.
newsitem.headline: Advanta retains adviser, COO resigns.

text.p: Advanta Corp Monday said it hired BT Wolfensohn to assist it in its review of its business strategy, growth prospects and operating environment aimed at maximizing Advanta's value for shareholders and other constituents.

Advanta said it has retained BT Wolfensohn to explore all strategic alternatives that build upon the historic strength and success of the company, including its mortgage, leasing and insurance operations as well as its core credit card business. There can be no assurance that the company will elect to pursue any of the strategic actions it may consider.

Advanta also said Alex "Pete" Hart, its chief executive officer, has assumed the additional responsibilities of David Brooks, its chief operating officer, who has resigned. The nature and responsibilities of the job of chief operating officer are now very different from what was contemplated when Brooks joined the company two months ago, Advanta said.
